limits: This rollup compresses risk evidence into root causes; it does not approve audio.
Root-cause grouping is deterministic and conservative, not a substitute for reading the source reports.
Human listening review and measured QC remain required before final delivery.

acceptance_criteria: plugin_validation_preflight has no blockers
plugin_semantic_validation_gate reports ready validation evidence
unsafe or unavailable plugins are disabled or kept manual-review only
next_root_cause.recommended_next_action: Run plugin preflight and semantic validation, then disable or remap unsafe plugins before any draft processing.
next_root_cause.title: Plugin availability and semantic write validation are not ready

acceptance_criteria: plugin_validation_preflight has no blockers
plugin_semantic_validation_gate reports ready validation evidence
unsafe or unavailable plugins are disabled or kept manual-review only
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Run plugin preflight and semantic validation, then disable or remap unsafe plugins before any draft processing.
root_causes.title: Plugin availability and semantic write validation are not ready

acceptance_criteria: source_acceptance_gate confirms explicit acceptance for the export source
source_handoff_readiness no longer has open stem requests for automatic processing
full-mix/reference tracks remain manual-review only and outside the premaster path
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Collect isolated stems or record explicit acceptance for a reviewed export source before final export.
representative_codes: high_risk_track:unsafe:V37 INSTRUMENTAL BUS free EQ pocket
root_causes.title: Accepted export source or required stems are missing

acceptance_criteria: artifact_signal_audit establishes usable source, metric, or feedback signal
artifact_evidence_gate separates measured evidence from report-only placeholders
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Collect measured artifact metrics, source signal, or user feedback before artifact-focused processing.
root_causes.title: Artifact-focused work lacks source, metric, or feedback evidence

acceptance_criteria: final_render_manifest contains a nonzero created primary WAV
final_render_evidence_gate is ready for final QC
the render path is not the selected source path and is not diagnostic-only
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Create a real primary WAV render from the accepted source and rerun final render evidence.
root_causes.title: Primary final WAV render evidence is missing or diagnostic-only

acceptance_criteria: final_qc_metrics has qc_passed true and no failures
final_qc_evidence_gate is ready for delivery QC
QC final_audio_path matches final render evidence primary WAV
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Run final QC on the primary WAV and validate QC evidence against render evidence.
root_causes.title: Final QC evidence is missing, failed, or not linked to render evidence

acceptance_criteria: final_ab_preview_manifest has created true and loudness_matched true
ab_preview_evidence_gate is ready for human A/B review
preview source_final matches the primary final WAV
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Create a measured loudness-matched A/B preview linked to the final render before approval.
root_causes.title: Loudness-matched A/B preview evidence is missing or invalid

acceptance_criteria: final_human_approval records accepted decision, reviewer, source, stage, final audio, and preview paths
final_approval_evidence_gate is ready for delivery request
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Record matched-loudness A/B listening approval after QC and preview evidence are ready.
root_causes.title: Final human approval evidence is missing or incomplete

acceptance_criteria: deliverable_package_manifest has package_created true and files_missing empty
deliverable_package_evidence_gate confirms ZIP integrity and required evidence files
credential-like and raw/reference paths are excluded by default
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Build a real deliverable ZIP after final evidence is ready and validate package evidence.
root_causes.title: Deliverable ZIP/package evidence is missing or incomplete

acceptance_criteria: final_delivery_consistency_gate is ready
final audio path matches render, QC, A/B, approval, and package evidence
A/B preview path matches preview and approval evidence
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Regenerate downstream reports from the accepted source until render, QC, A/B, approval, and package evidence paths agree.
root_causes.title: Final delivery reports do not yet prove cross-report consistency

acceptance_criteria: the source report no longer emits this blocker or warning
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Review the source report and choose the safest dry-run or manual-review action.
root_causes.title: Other open risks require manual review

acceptance_criteria: rollback_evidence_gate is ready for delivery readiness
project_state_manifest records original_tracks_protected true and master_unchanged true
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Repair rollback registry and project-state manifests before applied-stage or delivery confidence.
root_causes.title: Rollback or project-state protection evidence is incomplete

acceptance_criteria: feedback items are resolved only with measured QC and human review evidence
claim language guard and policy audits have no blockers
root_causes.recommended_next_action: Resolve feedback and static audit blockers without inventing listening approval.
root_causes.title: Feedback, claim language, or policy evidence still needs review
